regional_compliance.tax_context: GST/HST generally does not apply to licensed childcare services in most provinces (exempt supply); operators should confirm exemption status with CRA. Federal Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care (CWELCC) agreement has driven fee reductions and subsidy structures in most provinces.
regional_compliance.labor_regulation: Child-to-staff ratios set provincially, with significant variation by province and by age group of children served.
regional_compliance.licensing_bodies: Provincial ministry of education or social services licenses childcare facilities; requirements for background checks (vulnerable sector check), facility inspections, and Early Childhood Educator (ECE) certification vary by province.
key_compliance_terms: provincial ratio and group size regulations

humanity_mode_regional_addendum.0_percent: GST/HST exempt status of licensed childcare services, CWELCC fee reduction agreement implications for revenue and subsidy, provincial ECE certification requirements.

learning_objectives: Understand the GST/HST exempt status of licensed childcare in Canada and what that means for input tax credits.
Analyze how the federal CWELCC agreement has changed fee structures and subsidy revenue for Canadian childcare operators.

hardStops: Never takes real-world action without HITL approval
